ticket_ranger.text: Single file on the bridge, please! It sways. The bridge isn't scared. It's just very relaxed about the whole thing.
Fishermen built the first bridge to get to the salmon nets on the island. They'd haul the catch back across it with a rope and an attitude.

glen_walker.text: Nine glens in Antrim, and each has its own mood. This one's 'damp but proud'.
You can see Scotland from the coast on a clear day. I have never seen a clear day, but I'm told it's there.

lane_painter.text: I paint the Dark Hedges every year, and every year the trees have rearranged themselves.
In autumn the leaves go gold and everyone takes a photo. In winter they take the same photo, only greyer. I like both.

coast_cyclist.text: I'm following the Coastal Route on two wheels. Eighty kilometres of lovely scenery, and eleven of them are straight uphill into the wind.
Don't tell the sea, but I prefer the road.

gull.text: It stares at your lunch with the focus of a bank manager. You pretend not to notice. It knows.

arm_roadbowler.text: Armagh will tell you it is the home of the lofted bowl. It is a good road for it. Bends like a bag of snakes.
